title: Quick Copper
description: A set of QoL recipes: Quickly oxidize copper in a crafting table with wind charges, and scrape it all off just as easily in a stone cutter!
body:
Have you ever held a desire to build with oxidized copper blocks, but didn't want to wait for them to slowly reach that oxidization level? Well this is the datapack for you!

Quick Copper essentially adds 3 new recipes for every copper block variant:

- [Copper Block Variant] + Wind Charge = Next Oxidization Stage of [Copper Block Variant]
![Using a wind charge to convert a Copper Block into an Exposed Copper Block](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/152b7a7f8e36dfd90da38017f81be9be4c6ab9e1.png)
- 8 [Copper Block Variant] surrounding a Breeze Rod = 8 Next Oxidization Stage of [Copper Block Variant]
![Using a breeze rod to convert 8 Exposed Copper Trapdoors into 8 Weathered Copper Trapdoors all at once](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8f160b3bd86462b5487808cfc263c3c1f4ff6bcc.png)
- [Copper Block Variant] of any oxidization level can be placed into a Stone Cutter to quickly return it to any of its previous oxidization levels (if any exist)
![Using a stone cutter to scrape the oxidization off an Oxidized Copper Golem, transforming it into an Exposed Copper Golem](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/01bd92cdfe59a636cd122ba060477d401542a7b5.png)

Quick Copper additionally works on waxed copper blocks as well, allowing for quickly changing the oxidization level without needing to scrape off the wax!
